findings.desc: process-fact-registry.ts:262-268 the new PROCESS_FACT_ARTIFACT_BY_COMMAND entry is keyed milestone_closeout_capture, which is NOT a real registered command/process-fact name (it appears nowhere in process-fact-levels.ts, command-catalog.ts, or command-policy.ts). Every one of the ~60 pre-existing keys in this map (including the neighboring milestone_ledger_set/milestone_ledger_add entries) equals its own producerCommand AND matches a real PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS entry name, so COMMAND_PROCESS_FACTS wires it automatically via artifact: PROCESS_FACT_ARTIFACT_BY_COMMAND[entry.name] (process-fact-registry.ts:805; mirrored in scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:2017). Because the new key matches neither story_advance (already claimed by the index.json artifact at line 169) nor the real read-only command name milestone_closeout (process-fact-levels.ts:141), this artifact is unreachable from either commands own registry entry: getProcessFactRegistryEntry(story_advance)?.artifact stays index.json and getProcessFactRegistryEntry(milestone_closeout)?.artifact stays undefined, unlike the parity pattern asserted for delivery_check_set in tasks/delivery-check-freshness-smoke.ts:543-550. It only works today because PROCESS_FACT_ARTIFACTS artifact:milestone-closeout.json (line 979) dot-references the map directly, bypassing the by-name lookup, and the docs-drift script never cross-checks map keys against real command names, so the gap is silent. The codebase already has an established naming convention for exactly this situation (a sub-behavior of an existing command, not itself invocable): the runtime: prefix, e.g. runtime:declared_artifact_committed_check (process-fact-levels.ts:379, same owner handlers/story-advance), which this new entry does not use, so milestone_closeout_capture reads as if it were a real CLI command when it is not. Recommend renaming the key to runtime:milestone_closeout_capture (matching the established synthetic-key convention) or documenting why this entry intentionally breaks the key===producerCommand invariant.
findings.resolvedReason: Documented the deliberate key/producerCommand deviation at the map entry site (commit 63ff9181ac, 8-line comment): the key milestone_closeout_capture is a synthetic non-command handle because story_advance (the real producer via its DONE-time capture in handlers/milestone-status) already claims index.json, and a quoted runtime:-style key would break verify-process-fact-contract.mjs key extraction (unquoted [a-z_] keys + dot-access refs only). Round-1 finding explicitly offered rename OR document as acceptable; the round-2 quality re-review (review pass B-9188:RP-003 on run B-9188:RR-006) verified the parser-limitation claim against the script regexes at lines ~1829/2024/2035, confirmed producer attribution against transition-orchestrator.ts:601 and milestone-status.ts:94-147, and re-ran the contract script green.
